prompts.default:
Please draft markdown for a pull request with the following requirements:

1. Title: Clear, concise description of changes with relevant emoji
2. Body:
   - Detailed description of changes
   - Technical implementation notes if relevant
   - Demo section for images/videos (if applicable)
3. Format: Use Conventional Commits standard
4. Exclude: 'Related Issues' or 'Checklist' sections

Git Diff of changes:
prompts.commit:
Please generate a commit message following Conventional Commits standard:

1. Format: type(scope): description
2. Types: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, test, chore
3. Include relevant emoji
4. Keep description under 50 characters

Git Diff of changes:
prompts.detailed:
Please create a comprehensive pull request description with:

1. Title with emoji and clear description
2. Overview of changes
3. Technical details and implementation notes
4. Breaking changes (if any)
5. Testing instructions
6. Screenshots/demos (if applicable)
7. Follow Conventional Commits format

Git Diff of changes:
prompts.branch-name:
Please suggest appropriate branch names for these changes following Git naming conventions:

Requirements:
1. Use lowercase letters and hyphens (kebab-case)
2. Be descriptive but concise (max 50 characters)
3. Include type prefix: feat/, fix/, docs/, style/, refactor/, test/, chore/
4. Suggest 3-5 different options
5. Consider the main functionality being added/changed

Format your response as:
- option1
- option2
- option3
- option4
- option5
